_comment: break: 0 is deliberate: the nightly mutation job treats a score as a report to look at, never a gate. Added 2026-09-20 to close the 'only 2 of 8 src projects have mutation coverage' gap (docs/handoffs/2026-09-20-coverage-mutation-gaps-from-jaunty-probe.md). No `mutate` glob: 2,551 LOC is comparable to Analysis's already-unnarrowed 4,124, so whole-project mutation should run in a reasonable time -- caveat: this test project's csproj also owns ~22 Testcontainers fixtures (MsSql/PostgreSql/MySql/MariaDb), unlike Analysis. Stryker's coverage-based mode should scope per-mutant test runs to only the tests covering that mutant, so this shouldn't repeatedly spin up all 22 containers unless a mutant in Schema.Extraction's own code is covered only by a container-backed test -- unverified against a real nightly run. If this leg starts hitting the 240-minute job cap, look here first. This test project also covers Extrode.JauntyQ.Schema (see the sibling stryker-config.schema.json in this same directory) and Extrode.JauntyQ.SqlParser/Runtime, which is why `project` is set explicitly below rather than relying on single-reference inference.
